title: pass.cross
description: Several games (MULTI_GAME_PLAN §4.8, MG5): the player stands on a connecting route's pass (the far doorway of a gate house) and asks to cross into the other region. The server checks the pass, the target region (built, with a connected link) and that no crossing is under way, answers route.fade and waits for region.state; refusals come as error codes pass.no_region, pass.no_link, pass.not_built, pass.busy; pass.timeout ends a crossing that never finished.

dir.description: The end the player is heading to: "to" when standing in the route's from half, "from" when in its to half (the zone's pass.end says which half this is).
